Based on the links you pointed out, the bug is entirely within the decoder itself – namely in rtl/ibex_decoder.sv – but the fix will also touch the shared decode‐package (where the affected fields/instantiation are defined), the core (which instantiates the decoder) so that it still compiles/synthesizes cleanly, and the existing decoder testbench to ensure the formerly “dead” path is now exercised. The four files you will almost certainly need to update are:

```  
rtl/ibex_decoder.sv  
rtl/insn_decode_pkg.sv  
rtl/ibex_core.sv  
dv/ibex_decoder_tb.sv  
```
